'''Comm channel 3441.5''' was a communications channel utilized by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The channel was used by [[Drop Point: Gelgelar]] for approaching Alliance [[operative]]s, who were required to use their designated call signs to request landing instructions.<ref name="DP">{{JournalCite|14|Special Ops: Drop Points}}</ref>
